source.creator: Ashville

moment.source_excerpt: We'd done another couple of jobs and everybody owed us money and all of a sudden it's coming near Christmas time and we're struggling to pay bills cuz no one's paying us. So I was walking about looking at windows thinking how are we going to get over this? So I went to the so-called friend of mine and I managed to get some money off of him by going there and begging for my own money that I earned. And he did and the same man did knock me for money. I rang the crowd up we'd done the demolition job for. They said that we didn't do this. So I said what do you think this is? So I took a reduction on the job. We got paid for that. I'd done the same with the other couple of jobs. I gave them all money back. We didn't earn any real profit that year or that that for doing them jobs, but we actually got paid. So, we got over that Christmas and I thought No, this cannot happen again. This cannot happen again.
moment.caption: Busy jobs did not guarantee cash in the bank. Michael O’Donovan recalls chasing overdue payments before Christmas.
moment.note: Editorial selection from public timed captions; no replay data available. Opens with customers owing money and bills coming due; explains negotiating payment; ends with the lesson that this could not happen again.

moment.source_excerpt: We used to have a gang of drivers used to get there early and we'd all sit around and have a cup of coffee first thing in the morning. They'd go and do their walk-about checks, get ready to go. I'd walk down round with them. We'd have a crack. We'd have thing. They'd be off to wherever thing. Everybody had a bit of a spring in their step. And that to me meant everything. That drivers are going out being happy. Cuz if a driver goes out cuz he has cuz he's got the hump with you, he's going to wreck your lorry. He ain't going to care about your lorry. And when it comes to bank account, then it's irrelevant again because when your lorry's broke, you ain't earning no money to put in the bank account. So, you need everybody to be on your side. And then you are successful to have everybody pulling the rope the same way.
